headline: One simple way to add tasks, and every tap saved on your phone first.

highlights.title: One way to add a task
highlights.body: Today, the Tasks button, the widget and Ask ALIBI all add tasks the same way, and several tasks at once always open for review.

highlights.title: Every tap saved, even offline
highlights.body: Done, Pause, Tomorrow and Trash save on your phone at once and upload when you're back online.

highlights.title: Tomorrow keeps its time
highlights.body: Moving a task to tomorrow keeps the time it was due, from a reminder or in the app.

highlights.title: Reminders you can trust
highlights.body: Reminders show the real time left and when the task is due.
